title: Yellowed Crisp Uruguayan Myeolchi Anchovies Empanadas
description: Buttery and crisp Uruguayan empanadas filled with myeolchi anchovies and soffritto base, perfect for a cozy snack. This shojin-friendly dish is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, melted butter, and egg, mixing until a dough forms.
Gradually add the water to the dough, kneading until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Roll out each ball of dough into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of soffritto base and a few pieces of myeolchi anchovies in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the filling, forming a half moon shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of water and bake for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the empanadas from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
